before:
app "Dry clean" box ocean
table ticket name text, pieces num 1..40, ready date, collected bool
each ticket where collected = no sort ready as t empty "No tickets waiting"
  row card gap 2 tap edit t
    toggle t.collected
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.pieces "pieces" faint
    if t.ready <= today
      "Ready" color good
    else
      "in" plural(t.ready - today, "day") faint
form ticket, "New ticket"

each ticket where collected = no sort ready as t empty "No tickets waiting"
  row card gap 2 tap edit t
    toggle t.collected
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.pieces "pieces" faint
    if t.ready <= today
      "Ready" color good
    else
      "in" plural(t.ready - today, "day") faint
form ticket, "New ticket"

let b = sum(point.pts where team = Son)

    "Dad" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Son" bold
    b big

button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Dad win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Son win!" head color good
